caption: The drawing features a vertical mechanical apparatus, primarily rendered in shades of gray. The main object consists of a tall, cylindrical rod mounted on a wide, circular base for stability. Near the top of the rod, there is a large circular ring attached. About one-third down from the top, a rectangular bracket supports two small cylindrical containers; one of them has a lid and a handle attached to a chain. One metal rod projects downward from this bracket into the container. The apparatus appears symmetric along its central vertical axis. On the left side of the drawing, there are two supplementary diagrams: one is a side view and the other a top-down view, both showing simplified outlines of the main device. The overall composition is technical, with clean lines and detailed shading to suggest form and volume. The illustration is surrounded by a rectangular border, and an artist’s signature, “T. Staloff,” appears in the bottom left corner. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Betty Lamp
